title: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text: Article 8 (Submission of Agenda Items) The head of any ministry or agency who intends to submit an agenda item to the Strategy Meeting shall submit it to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism no later than three days before the meeting: Provided, That this shall not apply in an urgent case.
